title: Growth & Purpose - Government Public Service - Specialist Copy (Copy Writer) - Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte is looking for a senior analyst copywriter with a strong portfolio of innovative, high\-impact marketing campaigns. You will be working with a team of designers, digital producers, campaign managers, and strategic marketers to create content that engages clients and builds the Deloitte brand.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Specialist, Copy on the Government and Public Services (GPS) team, you will be responsible for
   

  

* Writing original copy for marketing campaign assets, including headlines, web copy, social media, email, collateral, and infographics
* Editing and proofreading content for grammar, punctuation, readability, flow, style, and alignment with Deloitte brand guidelines
* Collaborating with strategic marketing, program management, designers, and digital producers to develop campaign messaging, concepts, and assets
* Advising stakeholders on business objectives, content strategy, key messages, and Deloitte production processes
* Recommending creative channels, technologies, approaches, and content formats to support campaign effectiveness


**The team**
 The Government and Public Services (GPS) team provides solutions in support of market positioning and acquisition activities to maximize Deloitte’s revenue, relationships, and reputation in the Government marketplace. The India team provides efficient, flexible, quality support to SMs through innovative solutions that facilitate strategic decision making and works in collaboration with the US stakeholders in campaigns/activations, competitive intelligence support. Also, the team works closely with the US GPS channels under Client and Sales Excellence including Marketing and Communications, Information Management, Account Management, Competitive \& Market Intelligence, Pursuits, and Strategy.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad / Bengaluru
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 2 PM to 11 PM
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 4\-6 years of experience in copywriting and development of marketing communications assets
* Experience writing and editing content for digital and campaign channels, including web, email, social media, and collateral
* Experience collaborating with global stakeholders or cross\-border teams
* Experience proofreading and copyediting content for grammar, punctuation, readability, and style
* Portfolio demonstrating copywriting work across marketing or campaign assets
* Post Graduate degree in Communications, Journalism, Advertising, Marketing, English, or a similar field


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience in B2B marketing, professional services, consulting, industry, or advertising
* Experience supporting large\-scale marketing projects or working within a global organization
* Experience using Agile ways of working


**How You’ll Grow**
 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal to create a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\-based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\-art, world class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Deloitte’s culture**
 Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
   

  

**Corporate citizenship**
 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Communication Unified Events Head
description:
Head – Central University Engagement (CUE)
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Yrs
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Head – Central University Engagement (CUE)** 
 to own the communication governance and information flow across the university.
 



 The role will standardize communication templates, tone, messaging and channel usage across email, WhatsApp, social media, on\-campus communication and other channels. The role will ensure that all important programs and events reach the right stakeholders, including students, parents, faculty and other relevant groups.
 



  





 The CUE Head will also own the
 **unified events calendar** 
 across all campuses, covering academic, curricular, co\-curricular and extracurricular activities, providing leadership with a single view of all ongoing and upcoming events.
 



 The role will operate through a
 **hub\-and\-spoke model** 
 , where some communications may be executed directly by functions such as Parent Relationship or Student Relationship teams, while CUE maintains overall governance, standards, information flow and oversight.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  




* Own communication governance, including tone, messaging, quality and communication standards across the university.
* Develop and maintain standardized templates for
 **email, WhatsApp, social media, signage and other communication channels** 
 .
* Ensure programs and events reach all relevant stakeholders to drive awareness and participation.
* Audit and systemize the use of all communication channels and establish clear channel\-wise processes.
* Define the operating model for centrally executed versus team\-executed communications.
* Coordinate with teams executing their own communications while maintaining CUE's overall oversight and standards.
* Build and maintain a
 **unified end\-to\-end events calendar** 
 covering academic, curricular, co\-curricular and extracurricular events across all campuses.
* Identify and activate new communication channels such as classroom screens, standees, kiosks and other emerging platforms.
* Hire, train and manage a team of
 **4 CUE Executives** 
 , operating as a central shared pool with effective workload distribution.
* Work closely with
 **Parent Relationship, Student Relationship, PSM, Program Operations and University Partnerships** 
 teams to ensure timely flow of information and events into CUE.
* Establish processes to collect updates and event information from multiple functions and maintain a single source of truth.
* Track and report communication reach, effectiveness, channel performance and events\-calendar completeness to leadership.
* Provide leadership with a consolidated view of communication activities and events across the university.



  





 Who We're Looking For
 



  




* Experience leading a
 **central or company\-wide communications function** 
 , rather than communications for a single team or location.
* Experience working in a
 **hub\-and\-spoke communication model** 
 , setting standards and enabling other teams to execute effectively.
* Background in
 **Corporate Communications, Branding, Media, Marketing Communications or a related field** 
 .
* Strong ability to manage communication standards and influence multiple independent teams.
* Comfortable acting as a
 **single source of truth** 
 by consolidating inputs from multiple functions into one communication calendar and cadence.
* Channel\-agnostic approach with experience across
 **digital, social, email, WhatsApp, print and physical/on\-campus communication channels** 
 .
* Ability to identify and adopt new communication channels and technologies.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Experience hiring, mentoring and managing a small central communications team.
* Comfortable managing a
 **shared work queue and workload distribution** 
 rather than fixed individual territories.



  





 Key Skills
 



  





**Central Communications \| Corporate Communications \| Brand Communication \| Media \| Communication Governance \| Stakeholder Management \| Channel Management \| Content \& Messaging \| Event Communication \| Cross\-functional Coordination \| Team Management \| Digital Communication \| Social Media \| Email \& WhatsApp Communication**

title: Senior Strategist, Trust and Safety
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Experience in data analysis and stakeholder management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's or PhD degree in a quantitative field like engineering, computer science, mathematics, or statistics.
* Experience with scripting and coding (eg. C/C\+\+, Python, Java).
* Experience with fraud or policy investigations, fraud risk management, Internet advertising, or e\-commerce.
* Experience in roles related to business analysis, statistical analysis/machine learning.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical thinking skills with attention\-to\-detail in an ever\-changing environment.


**About the job** 
 Trust and Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.
   

  

 As a T\&S Ads Scams Analyst, you will be responsible for protecting users from offline scams, which take place outside the Google Ads Platform. You will use data to provide recommendations to products and devise solutions (global and hyperlocal) to stay ahead of the fraudsters. You will also be responsible for ensuring good advertisers are provided the right opportunity to serve. As an analyst, you will use Applied AI, machine learning or other techniques to optimize human review cost and efficiency while continuously identifying enforcement gaps and automation opportunities. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to achieve your business goals and lead projects end\-to\-end.At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust and Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with cross\-functional groups such as Product Management (PM), Engineering, Sales and Legal to drive projects that increases users' safety and provide better online experience through Google Ads.
* Execute complex queries and analyses, build visual models, and construct presentations on abuse trends to aid in fraud prevention and influence change in existing abuse detection systems without compromising advertiser experience.
* Conduct investigations to catch fraudsters, enforce product policies, learn scam patterns/trends and identify product vulnerabilities.
* Identify automation and efficiency opportunities and drive solutions through analysis or cross\-functional partnerships.
* Provide periodic on\-call coverage and address escalations from both internal and external stakeholders within established service level agreements, while acknowledging occasional exposure to some adult content and other potentially disturbing material during the course of these duties.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: QSC Q-Sys Operations Remote Support Engineer - APAC
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
 EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.
   

  

 We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.
   

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
 We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Audiovisual Engineering team. This technical role supports the global AV ecosystem that powers seamless communication and collaboration across the company. You’ll be responsible for the implementation, support, administration, and life cycle management of audio/video hardware and software, focusing not only on reliability, but also on automation, scripting, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with commercial AV technologies (QSC Q\-SYS, Shure, Dante), video conferencing systems (Google Meet, Zoom), and converged IP networks, paired with a strong foundation in automation tools, programming, and infrastructure as code. You’ll play a key role in driving innovation, improving support processes, and building repeatable solutions that reduce manual overhead. This position involves full lifecycle project ownership—from requirements gathering and design reviews through deployment and operational support—and may require occasional off\-hours work.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
* Own the implementation and support of AV technologies for deployment projects globally.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, and AV integrators to design, automate, and deploy solutions that align with company standards.
* Develop and manage scripts, tools, and automation pipelines for provisioning and managing AV systems.
* Analyze, test, install, document, and support audio/video over IP solutions in a global, converged network environment.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support AV operations and upgrades in production.
* Produce scopes of work, documentation (including AV schematics), and vendor communications for new AV installations or retrofits.
* Identify and recommend new technologies or automation strategies to improve scalability and efficiency.
* Maintain detailed documentation of deployed AV configurations, including change history and versioning.
* Lead or assist in root cause analysis and long\-term resolution of AV issues; mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting and automation techniques.
* Develop and manage project timelines, resource estimates, and product refresh schedules.
* Serve as Tier 3 support for complex AV issues and escalations in production environments.
* Travel up to 20% for deployments, testing, and operational support.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* QSC Q\-SYS certification, strong remote support experience
* 4\+ years in a corporate IT or AV integration environment, with at least 3 years working directly with commercial AV systems.
* Proficient in supporting video conferencing platforms such as Google Meet, Zoom, Logitech, and Neat.
* Programming and automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible, PowerShell) to build tools and automate repetitive AV tasks.
* Strong understanding of AV over IP technologies and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with AV control system logic and user interface design is a plus.
* Comfortable adapting to change and working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Skilled in breaking down complex issues into actionable solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; capable of translating technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Self\-starter with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bonus: Experience supporting live production events or hybrid broadcast\-style setups.


*EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.*

title: Junior Storage platform Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

 Storage and Backup Infrastructure Junior Engineer is responsible for delivering advanced Tier1/ Tier 2 support for the organization’s storage and backup environments. This role is focused on ensuring the reliability, security, and optimal performance of critical storage and backup systems by proactively monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues. The engineer works closely with cross\-functional teams to minimize service interruptions and maintain high data availability and integrity. Key responsibilities include managing and optimizing enterprise storage arrays, backup solutions, and related infrastructure, as well as implementing best practices for data protection and disaster recovery. By maintaining and enhancing the storage and backup landscape, the T2 – Storage and Backup Infrastructure Support Engineer plays an essential role in supporting business continuity and safeguarding organizational data assets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implement and manage storage solutions. Design, deploy, and maintain Storage Area Network (SAN), Network\-Attached Storage (NAS), and cloud storage environments to meet company needs.
* Monitor performance and capacity. Track storage system performance and utilization to identify bottlenecks and forecast future capacity needs. Implement performance tuning to optimize efficiency.
* Administer storage arrays. Configure and manage large\-scale storage arrays, including tasks like zoning, LUN provisioning, and volume management.
* Troubleshoot storage issues. Diagnose and resolve complex storage\-related problems, including connectivity issues, performance degradation, and data integrity errors.
* Perform routine maintenance. Conduct system maintenance, upgrades, and patching for storage hardware, operating systems, and related software.
* Decommission hardware. Handle the lifecycle of storage equipment, including decommissioning old hardware and re\-purposing existing resources.
* Manage backup and recovery systems. Administer enterprise backup software, like Cohesity, Veritas NetBackup, including scheduling and maintaining backup jobs.

**Job Summary** 





 We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Hardware Technician to handle computer hardware, networking, operating system, and software\-related technical issues. The candidate should be capable of diagnosing and resolving both routine and critical hardware and software problems efficiently.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Hardware Technician is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining desktops, laptops, servers, and peripheral devices such as printers, routers, and switches. The technician will diagnose and resolve hardware issues, replace faulty components, and perform routine preventive maintenance to reduce downtime. Daily tasks include responding to support requests, documenting hardware configurations and repairs, coordinating with vendors for hardware procurement and warranty services, and ensuring that all equipment complies with company security and performance standards. The role may also involve assisting with hardware upgrades for system optimization and supporting project rollouts across the organization.
 



  





**Qualifications**

* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in clear, accessible language to non\-technical users.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.

 Successful outcome of a National Police Check

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).


 This position is aligned with the Core Talent Model. To view the associated benefit package, please reference this document https://resources.deloitte.com/sites/dnet\-tod\-usi/Shared Documents/Benefits/USIBenefitsBrochureforPlanG.pdf
   

  

**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

TOPS serves as technology escalation group for internal help desks and development teams. The ASA will support multiple brokerage applications as a member of this centralized application support team. ASA focus will be providing Tier 2/3 technology support that includes incident ticket management, production support release coordination, system monitoring and issue analysis across entire LPL application platform.

ASA will be instrumental in gathering data facts and providing solutions to our technology support partners; with proactive and timely communications. title: Sr Manager, SSO Engineering People Leader (Cyber Security)
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
   

  

 As a Senior SSO Engineering People Leader, you will provide strategic direction and senior functional leadership for teams delivering enterprise SSO, modern authentication, federation, and identity security capabilities. This role requires strong technology understanding, broad functional experience, and the ability to lead people leaders or senior engineers through complex, high\-impact identity initiatives. You will shape engineering priorities, influence enterprise identity strategy, strengthen operational resiliency, and ensure authentication services support business growth, security, compliance, and client trust.
   

  

 The Senior SSO Engineering People Leader owns broader execution strategy, operational governance, and functional leadership for SSO engineering capabilities across enterprise platforms, applications, and identity ecosystems. The role is accountable for roadmap alignment, talent development, stakeholder engagement, risk reduction, audit readiness, platform modernization, and measurable delivery outcomes. This leader will partner with senior technology, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, application, infrastructure, and business leaders to advance secure, scalable, and user\-centered identity services
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide overall leadership for the SSO Engineering function, including senior engineers, technical leads, and other IAM engineering resources.
* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for enterprise authentication, federation, and SSO services.
* Provide leadership and governance across technologies including SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, federation, MFA, passwordless authentication, FIDO2, passkeys, and adaptive authentication.
* Establish architecture and engineering standards for enterprise authentication platforms.
* Lead modernization of legacy authentication patterns toward standards\-based, cloud\-ready, and Zero Trust\-aligned architectures.
* Provide strategic leadership for platforms such as PingFederate, PingAccess, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent identity technologies.
* Drive platform scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, high availability, security, observability, and operational maturity.
* Establish standardized patterns for workforce, application, API, cloud, and service authentication.
* Partner with enterprise architecture and cybersecurity teams to define target\-state authentication architecture.
* Drive automation across application onboarding, configuration management, testing, deployments, certificate management, and platform operations.
* Champion CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, policy\-as\-code, automated testing, and DevSecOps practices within IAM engineering.
* Provide governance and technical oversight for high\-risk or complex authentication integrations.
* Lead major platform transformations, migrations, upgrades, consolidations, and modernization initiatives.
* Establish controls to address authentication threats including credential compromise, token misuse, session attacks, unauthorized access, and configuration vulnerabilities.
* Ensure authentication capabilities meet applicable regulatory, cybersecurity, risk, audit, and enterprise control requirements.
* Own engineering performance metrics and executive reporting covering reliability, availability, security, delivery, incidents, onboarding, automation, and technical debt.
* Partner with Product and Application Engineering leaders to prioritize demand and establish scalable application onboarding models.
* Lead capacity planning, workforce strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management, and engineering skill development.
* Serve as an escalation point for critical authentication incidents and major technology risks.
* Influence senior leaders and stakeholders on identity strategy, technology investments, engineering priorities, and risk decisions.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, 12\+ years of technology experience, with substantial experience in IAM, cybersecurity, authentication, or enterprise security engineering.
* Extensive experience designing or leading enterprise\-scale SSO and federation platforms.
* Deep understanding of SAML 2\.0, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA, PKI, certificates, session management, and modern authentication patterns.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise IAM technologies such as Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or comparable platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading senior engineers and complex engineering organizations.
* Experience establishing technical roadmaps, architecture standards, engineering governance, and operating models.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust and identity\-centric security architecture.
* Experience with cloud, APIs, containers, CI/CD, automation, and modern software engineering practices.
* Demonstrated success delivering large, complex, cross\-functional technology programs.
* Strong executive communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, SC\-300, AZ\-500, enterprise architecture, cloud security, or relevant identity provider certifications are desirable.
* Experience leading IAM engineering within financial services or another highly regulated enterprise.
* Experience modernizing large\-scale legacy authentication environments.
* Knowledge of Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance, Non\-Human Identities, secrets management, API security, and machine\-to\-machine authentication.
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms, cloud\-native architectures, and public cloud security.
* Knowledge of identity threat detection, authentication telemetry, SIEM/SOC integration, and continuous monitoring.
* Relevant cybersecurity, IAM, architecture, cloud, or leadership certifications.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity, Zscaler Private Access, FIDO2/Passkeys, SCIM, REST APIs, Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Git, CI/CD, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, identity analytics, observability, AI\-driven identity security, and Non\-Human Identity management.

title: Software Engineering PMTS - Cloud Security - Hyderabad
description:
**Description**
 Come join our growing Hyperforce Enterprise Security organization. We are chartered with architecting, implementing, and operating security solutions that protect Salesforce’s complex, multi\-cloud technology landscape at scale.
   

  

 As a Principal Member of Technical Staff, you will provide technical leadership in building the next generation of infrastructure security and developer security guardrails. You will work across the software development and deployment lifecycle to identify security risks early, build scalable controls, and enable secure\-by\-default engineering practices without compromising developer velocity.
   

  

 Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high\-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments.
   

  

 You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands\-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production\-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation.
   

  

 This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams.
* Design and build scalable shift\-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production.
* Architect and build shift\-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths.
* Design scalable policy\-as\-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments.
* Drive risk\-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high\-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally.
* Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems.
* Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities.
* Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services.
* Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services.
* Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle — requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve security coverage, automation, detection quality, enforcement, and developer experience.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for reliability, scalability, observability, testing, and operational readiness of security services.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Influence technical strategy and roadmap decisions across teams and drive initiatives from concept through production.
* Build and ship high\-quality, production\-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high\-quality code.
* Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.
* Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.
* Critically evaluate code (human or AI\-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large\-scale production systems.
* Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production\-quality systems.
* Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems.
* Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade\-offs to senior technical and business audiences.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Deep experience in cloud\-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security.
* Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale.
* Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and security\-as\-code frameworks.
* Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security.
* Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact.
* Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation.
* Experience designing developer\-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience.
* Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi\-team initiatives.
* A demonstrated, genuine AI\-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
* Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.
* Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production\-ready


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, you will be expected to:
   

  

* Raise the technical bar for infrastructure and developer security engineering.
* Build security controls that are effective, scalable, reliable, and developer\-friendly.
* Move security closer to the point where risks are introduced through strong shift\-left and automated enforcement.
* Improve the ability to distinguish noise from meaningful and exploitable risk.
* Establish consistent security coverage and enforcement across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Drive complex initiatives from architecture and design through implementation, production deployment, and operational maturity.
* Identify gaps in the current security landscape and proactively develop innovative solutions to address them.

title: Infrastructure Platform Engineering (SMTS, Software Engineering)
description:
**Description**
**About the Role
   

  

 Title \- Software Engineer, SMTS \- Infrastructure Platform Engineering**
 We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer to contribute to high\-impact modernization and cloud platform efforts at Salesforce. A core focus is supporting the migration of Tableau's legacy hypervisor and VM infrastructure into Salesforce\-managed infrastructure — owning defined workstreams (e.g., discovery, design, and delivery for a specific domain or service area) within a broader effort spanning Public Cloud, Networking, Security, SRE, and Database teams. More broadly, this role also builds and operates scalable, secure public cloud solutions (AWS, with Azure/GCP exposure) as part of the platform team.
   

  

 You'll bring solid technical depth to discovery conversations, help translate ambiguous legacy environments into concrete implementation plans for your area, and contribute to a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 You'll bring deep technical credibility to discovery conversations, translate ambiguous legacy environments into clear architectural plans, and help build a reusable migration and platform engineering foundation that serves future acquisitions and ongoing cloud operations alike.
   

  

 If you thrive in environments where the map doesn't exist yet and you have the skills to draw it, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Conduct technical discovery for a defined portion of the legacy infrastructure (e.g., a specific service or workload class within Tableau's hypervisor/VM environment), documenting findings and gaps for your area
* Partner with Public Cloud, Networking, Security, Storage, OS, and SRE teams to design and implement your piece of the target infrastructure architecture (AWS, Private Cloud, or hybrid), working from the broader architecture direction set by architects/LMTS\+ leads
* Develop and implement cloud solutions for medium\-complexity problems, designing for performance, scalability, and reliability
* Produce implementation plans for your workstream — design, effort estimates, resource needs — and deliver reliably against them
* Execute migration and modernization work for your assigned portion of the legacy VM\-based infrastructure, ensuring continuity of dependent services throughout the transition
* Build components with reusability in mind, contributing to a scalable migration framework and infrastructure model that reduces repeated engineering effort for future M\&A integrations
* Build, maintain, and deploy infrastructure as code (IaC) and modern CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment velocity
* Build automation for operations, self\-healing systems, proactive alerting, and event auto\-remediation within your area
* Collaborate across infrastructure disciplines to deliver your workstream on schedule, escalating cross\-team dependencies as needed
* Apply and help refine security and networking standards aligned with Salesforce requirements (e.g., supporting retirement of legacy auth systems)
* Participate in an on\-call rotation to ensure timely incident response, root\-cause analysis, and minimal downtime
* Document decisions, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational playbooks to support long\-term maintainability


**Coding \& Technical Depth**
 Given The Scope Of Building On AWS, Working At The Hypervisor Level, And Supporting Large\-scale File Transport, Candidates Should Be Comfortable Coding — Not Just Configuring — Across
   

  

* Infrastructure\-as\-Code \& automation: Terraform, Ansible/Puppet, and Python for tooling, orchestration, and operational scripts
* AWS SDK/API\-level development: boto3 (Python) or AWS SDK for Go/Java, to build directly against AWS APIs (EC2, VPC, S3, EBS, networking) rather than console/Terraform alone
* Hypervisor/virtualization internals: experience with VMware APIs (vSphere API/PowerCLI), KVM/libvirt, or Nitro\-based EC2 bare metal for building and operating hypervisor infrastructure including vSphere clustering, HA/DRS configuration, and storage vMotion\-level troubleshooting
* Large\-scale file transport \& data movement: experience with high\-throughput transfer protocols and services — AWS DataSync, Transfer Family, S3 multipart/accelerated transfer — for large file transport projects on AWS
* Systems\-level languages: Go or Java for performance\-sensitive, throughput\-heavy infra tooling, alongside Python for automation
* Networking\-level coding: scripting/automating routing, SDN, and network virtualization configs where hypervisor build\-out includes network virtualization
* Linux/Windows OS fundamentals: Solid Linux administration skills and working knowledge of Windows Server administration


**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
* 6\-8\+ years of infrastructure engineering experience, with a strong background in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps
* Hands\-on experience with hypervisor/VM environments (VMware vSphere, ESXi, Hyper\-V, KVM, or equivalent) and/or public cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP a plus)
* Proven experience migrating on\-prem or legacy VM workloads to public or private cloud at scale by applying appropriate migration strategies (lift\-and\-shift, re\-platform, or re\-architect) based on workload constraints
* Deep understanding of networking fundamentals — VPCs, VLANs, routing, firewall rules, DNS, load balancing
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles: identity management, Okta/SSO integration, zero\-trust networking, secrets management
* Proficiency with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure
* Demonstrated ability to conduct technical discovery in complex legacy environments and produce structured architecture documentation and effort decompositions
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycles
* Comfortable operating across multi\-disciplinary teams — able to hold detailed technical conversations with storage engineers, security architects, and SREs in the same day
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present architecture decisions and trade\-offs clearly to technical and leadership audiences

**AI Architect** 

*Enterprise AI \| Generative AI \| Agentic AI \| Cloud Architecture \| Hyderabad* 




 Generative AI and agentic systems are moving from pilots to the core of how enterprises operate — and Tachyon Technologies is where that shift is being architected. We're looking for a senior AI Architect who wants to own that transformation end to end: designing the systems, setting the standards, and seeing solutions run in production at enterprise scale, not just in a slide deck.
 



 This is a role for someone who has already done real cloud architecture, has since built genuine depth in LLMs, RAG, and agentic design, and wants a platform where that combination is the whole job — not a side project bolted onto something else.
 


**What You Will Do** 
* Architect end\-to\-end enterprise AI solutions spanning applications, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, integrations, and user experience.
* Design and lead Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, enterprise search, tool/function calling, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Define cloud\-native architectures for AI workloads on Azure, AWS, and/or GCP using managed AI services, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless patterns.
* Evaluate and select models, frameworks, vector databases, and cloud services against business, security, performance, and cost requirements.
* Design integrations between AI solutions and enterprise platforms — Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, ERP/CRM, data platforms, and external APIs.
* Create architecture blueprints, reference patterns, reusable components, and technical standards for AI delivery.
* Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, design reviews, and proof\-of\-concept initiatives with engineering and customer teams.
* Define AI evaluation and observability approaches — grounding, accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, and safety.
* Establish guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, identity and access models, and Responsible AI practices.
* Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, and help build strong architecture practice across AI initiatives.
  


**What You Bring** 
* 15\+ years in software engineering, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or cloud architecture, with recent hands\-on technical work.
* A production GenAI or Agentic AI system you've personally architected and shipped — not a POC — using LLMs, RAG, tool/function calling, or multi\-agent orchestration.
* Deep, hands\-on cloud architecture experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP; multi\-cloud experience is a strong plus.
* Working fluency with modern AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Strong software engineering foundation with hands\-on programming, preferably Python, and the ability to review implementation\-level decisions.

* Experience building reusable AI platforms, accelerators, or enterprise AI capabilities.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), knowledge graphs, or advanced enterprise search.
* Background in customer\-facing architecture, solutioning, or technical consulting.
  


**Why Tachyon** 
* Own architecture decisions on high\-visibility enterprise AI programs, from first workshop to production rollout.
* Work at the intersection of deep cloud engineering and cutting\-edge agentic AI — not one at the expense of the other.
* Shape reusable patterns and standards that other architects and engineers will build on.
* Direct exposure to customer stakeholders and technology leadership, with real influence over technical direction.

title: Process Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Our Finance team is not just another department; we're strategic partners and catalysts for change, who use our expertise to drive sustainable growth and create and protect value for Reckitt.
   

  

 With a strong emphasis on cross\-functional collaboration and partnership, our inclusive, diverse and energised team breaks down traditional barriers, enabling you to thrive in a dynamic environment where you and your ideas matter.
   

  

 From leveraging insights and analysis to make data\-driven decisions \- to spearheading sustainable business practices that contribute to consistent and reliable business growth \- we are unwaveringly passionate about making a meaningful impact, and always doing the right thing.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Process Intelligence Specialist is responsible for delivering data‑driven insights into how business processes actually run, using process mining, modelling, and advanced analytics. The role focuses on hands‑on analysis, converting complex process data into clear, actionable insights that help teams improve service, cost, speed, adherence, and automation readiness. This role works closely with process leads, business operations, data analytics, transformation teams, IT, and analytics functions and plays a key role in embedding process intelligence into day‑to‑day decision‑making.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Model process flows, ensure quality of modelled processes and act as SME to support \& coach business modelers
* Develop As‑Is and To‑Be process models based on input of process owners, operations and real execution data
* Support process standardization efforts while clearly highlighting justified local or channel‑specific variants
* Contribute to scenario and impact modelling (e.g. what\-if models for promotions, capacity constraints, demand shocks)
* Set\-up \& Analysis of end‑to‑end process mining use cases on end\-to\-end processes e.g., O2C, S2P, R2R, Hire\-to\-Retire, Plan\-to Fulfil
* Discover actual execution flows, variants, bottlenecks, rework, and deviations from standard processes
* Support audit, SOX, and regulatory requirements with data‑based evidence
* Help define preventive controls and leading indicators
* Translate analytical findings into clear, business‑oriented insights
* Create dashboards, views, and visuals that answer, “what happened, why, and where to act.”


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 5\-7 years in process analytics, process improvement, or operational analytics
   

  

 Hands‑on experience with process intelligence tools
   

  

 Exposure to FMCG, consumer goods, or other high‑volume operational environments preferred
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Data Analytics or related field
   

  

 Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, Agile working, Process Mining, Analytics are a plus
   

  

 The skills for success
   

  

 Process Mining, Celonis, Process data analysis, Business process transformation, Six Sigma, Finance Process transformaiton, Lean, Process Intelligence, Process Modelling
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.
