 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills

**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and other international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients through the full building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design to construction, commissioning, and asset management. The consultancy works on a wide range of projects, including high\-rise and supertall buildings, commercial, residential, hospitality, healthcare, transport infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments. As a manufacturer\-neutral advisor, D\&B provides recommendations driven by safety, performance, operational efficiency, and lifecycle needs rather than equipment supply. The role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams, attending project meetings, and maintaining accurate project records and documentation. This is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Hyderabad, with a mix of office\-based work and some flexibility to work from home. The trainee will receive guidance and training to develop technical competence, professional communication skills, and an understanding of industry standards and best practices.

* Attention to detail, commitment to safety and quality, and willingness to learn about Vertical Transportation and Façade Access systems.
* Any internship or academic project experience in building services, mechanical systems, or construction\-related fields is beneficial.

title: Senior API Platform Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for an API Developer who builds the platform APIs other teams depend on, and runs them in production. You will write the code in
 **TypeScript and Python** 
 , and you will own the
 **Kubernetes** 
 deployments, pipelines and monitoring that keep it running.
   

  

 These are platform APIs, so your users are other developers. That changes how you work: an API only succeeds if it is easy to adopt. We want someone who puts themselves in the user’s shoes before shipping.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Building Platform Capabilities**
* Design and build APIs in TypeScript and Python that other teams use as building blocks
* Treat other developers as your customers. Talk to them, understand how they will integrate, and design for that
* Write clear OpenAPI contracts, useful documentation and error messages that actually help the caller
* Pick sensible defaults so the common case works with minimal setup
* Keep versioning and backwards compatibility in mind, so adopting your API today does not create work for someone tomorrow


**Deployment \& Operations**
* Package services as containers and deploy them to Kubernetes, writing and maintaining your own Helm charts
* Ship through GitOps with Flux, so what is in the repository is what is running in the cluster
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for automated testing, building and release
* Configure the API layer in front of your services: routing, authentication, rate limiting and versioning
* Instrument your services with OpenTelemetry so traces, metrics and logs show you a problem before a user reports it
* Debug issues across application code, infrastructure and networking


**Working in the Team**
* Take a problem with its context and come back with a proposal. You will not be handed a solution to implement
* Review other people’s code and take review well on your own
* Work with security and operations to keep services aligned with our controls


**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Must Have**
* 3–5 years building production APIs, comfortable in both TypeScript and Python
* Good grasp of API design and OpenAPI (REST conventions, versioning, error handling, pagination)
* Real Kubernetes experience: you can debug a pod that will not start, not just deploy to a cluster someone else built
* Hands\-on with Docker and Helm
* CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions
* Familiar with authentication patterns such as OAuth2, OIDC and JWT
* Working knowledge of relational databases
* You use AI tools every day, to get up to speed on unfamiliar technology, to explore options before committing, and to move faster on routine work, while still understanding what you ship. Tell us how you use them.
* Able to work autonomously, raise questions early and own a piece of the platform end to end
* Fluent in English


**Nice to Have**
* API gateway experience such as Kong, a plus and not a requirement. We will train the right person
* GitOps tooling such as Flux or Argo CD
* OpenTelemetry and an observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or similar)
* Event\-driven architectures and messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus)
* Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure)
* Terraform basics, enough to provision your own databases, caches and queues
* GraphQL
* Previous platform engineering or developer experience work
* Background in financial services or another regulated industry


 Mindset
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks about the developer on the other end of the API, and asks "would I want to integrate with this?" before shipping
* Enjoys building the foundations other people build on
* Is curious and self\-directed, you research what you do not know rather than waiting to be taught
* Uses AI as a normal working tool, not a novelty, and stays critical of what it gives back
* Is comfortable owning a service from the API contract through to production
* Prefers asking a good question early over guessing quietly


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per\-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high\-quality, lean designs and implementations.

Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

description:
**About Guidant Global:** 




 Guidant Global delivers dynamic, tailored workforce solutions that empower businesses to thrive in ever\-evolving markets. Through our MSP, RPO, Direct Sourcing, Services Procurement and Consulting services, we help organizations find, engage, and manage the best permanent and contingent talent across the globe.
 



 Part of Impellam Group, we champion A Better Way, a people\-first approach that integrates deep industry expertise with advanced technology. Our technology turns workforce complexity into clarity, with real\-time insights that support smarter talent decisions at scale.
 



 With over 1\.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80\+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.
 



  





**About Guidant Global India:** 




 At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability centre, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.
 



 We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in\-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future\-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.
 



 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a Data Platform Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and observability of the Headless Data Architecture (HDA), built on Databricks and Azure. You will ensure data and AI pipelines run reliably in production across multiple regions and continuously improve the platform through automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cost optimization.
 



 Working at the intersection of DataOps, MLOps, and Platform Engineering, you will also help enable AI capabilities through evaluation, prompt management, guardrails, and AI\-assisted tooling.
 



 This role sits at the foundation of HFG’s ambition to become an AI\-powered Workforce\-as\-a\-Service (WaaS) organization. Your work ensures that everything built on top of the platform — from analytics and data products to AI applications — can run reliably, securely, and at scale.
 



 You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, Cloud Engineers, and governance stakeholders to continuously improve the platform and enable the organization to make better use of data and AI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Operate and maintain the end\-to\-end HDA data and AI platform on Databricks and Azure, covering data ingestion, processing, analytics, AI, and serving layers.
* Manage and evolve Unity Catalog governance, including workspace and meta store configuration, access control, credential management, and regional data\-sharing structures.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues across data and ML pipelines, driving structured incident response, root\-cause analysis, and continuous reliability improvements.
* Build and maintain data ingestion and integration pipelines, including SnapLogic\-based integrations between VMS, HR systems, and the HDA.
* Implement and operate platform\-wide observability using Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring, providing both operational monitoring and strategic platform insights.
* Automate and standardize platform operations using Infrastructure\-as\-Code and Databricks deployment tooling, including compute management, job scheduling, scaling, and cost optimization.
* Contribute to the team’s AI\-accelerated engineering tooling, including the UC4 AI\-powered development workbench and supporting MCP\-based capabilities.
* Manage the AI\-platform lifecycle, including prompt versioning, model evaluation, deployment workflows, and environment promotion.
* Implement and operate AI guardrails and safety mechanisms, including input/output validation, PII protection, toxicity detection, and monitoring of AI quality and reliability.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Platform Engineers, and Cloud Engineers to ensure the data and AI platform is secure, reliable, scalable, and production\-ready.
* Continuously improve platform performance, resilience, automation, and operational efficiency across regions and environments.



  





**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks in production, including cluster and compute management, job orchestration, Unity Catalog administration, Delta Live Tables / Lake flow, and production troubleshooting, workspace administration, compute policy enforcement, Databricks Apps management, and multi\-environment workspace configuration.
* Experience administering a Databricks workspace at an organizational level, including Unity Catalog metastore setup, workspace\-to\-megastore binding, catalog and schema hierarchy design, storage credential and external location management, attribute\-based access control, data lineage propagation, and Delta Sharing configuration for cross\-workspace and cross\-region data sharing.
* Experience managing Databricks compute governance, including cluster policies, instance pool configuration, autoscaling rules, spot and on\-demand compute mix, cost attribution tagging, and budget alerting through Azure Cost Management integration.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) for deploying notebooks, jobs, pipelines, and model\-serving endpoints across development, staging, and production environments, including bundle configuration, deployment targets, and integration with CI/CD tooling.
* Experience operating the Mosaic AI platform, including the AI Gateway for LLM call routing and rate limiting, Model Serving endpoint configuration and traffic management, MLflow model registry governance, and Databricks Apps deployment.
* Strong experience with Azure data platform services, including ADLS Gen2, Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), networking, Key Vault, resource management, and cost optimization.
* Experience building and operating data ingestion and integration pipelines using SnapLogic or a similar iPaaS, with a good understanding of REST, JDBC, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong understanding of Delta Lake and data engineering patterns, including ACID transactions, table optimization, streaming ingestion, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and GitOps, using technologies such as Terraform and Databricks Asset Bundles.
* Experience with CI/CD for data platforms, including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, automated testing, deployment gates, and environment promotion.
* Experience with observability and platform reliability, including OpenTelemetry, Grafana Cloud, dashboards, alerting, and defining meaningful SLOs/SLAs.
* Strong automation skills using Python and/or Scala.
* Experience implementing data quality frameworks, such as Great Expectations or Databricks\-native data quality capabilities, including automated validation and expectation management.
* Experience with AI/ML evaluation and validation, using frameworks such as Mosaic AI Evaluation, RAGAS, or equivalent, including LLM\-as\-Judge approaches and metrics such as faithfulness, relevance, and groundedness.
* Experience managing the AI lifecycle, including prompt versioning, prompt\-to\-model binding, environment promotion, and model evaluation across development, staging, and production.
* Understanding of AI safety and guardrails, including input/output validation, PII protection, toxicity detection, hallucination monitoring, and integration with model\-serving endpoints.
* Experience designing or maintaining governed registries for AI capabilities, including agent skills, tool\-use bindings, and MCP server endpoints, with versioning and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of data platform operations, including incident management, root\-cause analysis, performance optimization, resilience, and cost management.
* Ability to translate data, AI, and platform requirements into reliable, scalable, and operationally maintainable solutions.
* Experience working effectively across Data Engineering, AI/ML, Platform Engineering, and Cloud Engineering teams.

 Join EY and help build a better working world.

**The opportunity**
 As a TR\-ITC manager, you’ll contribute technically to Risk Assurance client engagements and internal projects. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with stakeholders as required.
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer(client/onshore). As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Proficiency in using audit software tools, data analytics techniques, and IT auditing techniques. Strong analytical skills are necessary for interpreting technical data, identifying patterns, anomalies, and areas of concern.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to IT governance, data protection, privacy, and cybersecurity. This includes regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and industry frameworks like COBIT and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

* Proficiency in identifying, assessing, and managing IT\-related risks to ensure that adequate controls are in place to mitigate potential threats to the organization's information assets, systems, and operations.

* Proficiency in understanding IT systems, networks, applications, and infrastructure to design and implement controls effectively. This includes knowledge of common technology platforms, such as operating systems, databases, cloud services, and cybersecurity tools.
* Strong project management skills are necessary for planning, coordinating, and executing internal control initiatives effectively. This includes managing resources, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure that control objectives are achieved in a timely and efficient manner.
* The ability to lead and mentor a team of IT control professionals, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities. Strong leadership qualities include decision\-making, delegation, conflict resolution, and fostering a collaborative work environment.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, IT leadership, internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities. This involves understanding stakeholder expectations, managing communications, and addressing concerns in a collaborative and constructive manner.
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in application controls and Information security experience.
* Ability to build relationships with key stakeholders across different levels of seniority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* Preferably Bachelor’s degree in (Finance/Accounting, Electronics, Electronics \& Telecommunications, Comp. Science)/MBA/M.Sc./CA
* Minimum of 7\-8 years of experience in internal controls and Internal Audit
* Enterprise risk services with specific focus on IT and related industry standards
* IT Risk Assurance framework
* Control frameworks such as COSO, internal control principles and related regulations including SOX and J\-SOX
* Preferred security skills related to a broad range of operating systems, databases or security tools, e.g., UNIX, Linux, Windows 2000 and NT, firewalls and IDS systems
* Familiarity with IT analysis, delivery and operations methods, including ITGC, ITAC,SDLC, PAM and CM
* Familiarity with security and risk standards such as ISO 27001\-2, PCI DSS, NIST, ITIL, COBIT
* Experience of security testing methods and techniques including network, operating and application system configuration review
* Application controls and security experience:
+ sensitive access and SOD testing

title: Consultant, Technology Engineer - Network Engineering, India
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
   

  

 We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Engineer to design, implement, and maintain our network infrastructure. This role includes managing virtual and physical network environments, ensuring optimal performance, security, and reliability across all systems. This position will also oversee the physical connectivity of our office location in Hyderabad, including cabling, hardware setup, and on\-site troubleshooting.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement network constructs to achieve business outcomes (e.g., B2B connectivity, internet connectivity, third party connectivity, etc.)
* Configure and install network hardware and software (routers, switches, access points, etc.)
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure high availability
* Manage and maintain physical network infrastructure, including:
* Office cabling (Ethernet, fiber, patch panels)
* Network closets and racks
* Physical setup and relocation of network devices
* Coordinate with vendors and contractors for structured cabling and hardware installations
* Perform regular network maintenance and upgrades
* Implement and enforce network security protocols and policies
* Provide Level 3 escalation support for network\-related issues
* Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations and physical layouts


  

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Proven experience as a Network Engineer or similar role
* Strong understanding of network protocols and services (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, DHCP, DNS, 802\.1x, IPSec etc.)
* Experience with physical network infrastructure and structured cabling
* Demonstrable familiarity with Cisco internetworking solutions
* Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills


**Required Skills**
* Cisco CCNP certification
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP
* Strong understanding of network routing protocols (CCNP\-level)
* Demonstrable network automation experience
* Experience with Infrastructure/Network as Code workflows (e.g., Git, Ansible, Terraform)
* AWS Networking Fundamentals


**Desired Skills**
* Experience with deployment pipelines and infrastructure as code methodology is highly desired
* Experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure)
* Knowledge of VoIP systems and wireless networking
* Scripting for automation (Python, Bash)
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools


**Job Description Summary**
 Nationwide is a leading insurance and financial services provider committed to delivering extraordinary care to its customers. With a growing presence in India, our technology teams play a vital role in driving innovation and supporting global operations. Nationwide's industry\-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
   

  

 As a Consultant, Technology Engineer, you deliver standard and custom supportable technology products. The solutions you build are based on Nationwide’s architectural standards, technology roadmaps, industry trends, and business requirements. You’ll focus on collaboration, data, systems, storage, middleware, network, security, and contact center technology products. You’ll also be accountable for the operational aspects and management for the above products according to the business requirements and defined service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Collaborates with Technology Architecture professionals to develop technology product roadmaps.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Designs and implements standard builds/templates for all technology platforms.
* Drives product improvements through optimization, enhancements and the implementation of new features and functions.
* Works continuously with other Technology Engineering teams and Technology Architecture to ensure the success of products.
* Conducts “proof of concept” labs for enhancements, new solutions and competitive bake\-offs.
* Designs standard and custom technology solutions for business partner projects, including pre\- production testing, performance tuning, handoffs and certification.
* Conducts proactive and reactive monitoring to detect, predict and resolve abnormal conditions in the environment.
* Collaborates with vendors to help drive design innovation in product enhancements and improvements.
* Executes on production engineering processes, incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, change management, release management and knowledge management.
* Provides complex production support for all technology platforms.
* Provides oversight for technical labs and development environments.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
 May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
   

  

**Education**
 Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or other related degree.
   

  

**Experience**
 Six years or more experience with the most complex integrated solutions with an ability to design and develop and modify new and existing solutions for specialized needs. Experience with multiple technologies and/or domains. Experience with automation of deployment of solution configurations,
   

  

**Technical Skills**
* Cloud Platform Systems
* Computer Science
* Design Thinking
* DevSecOps
* Engineering Management
* Engineering Support
* IT Infrastructure
* Infrastructure as Code


**Soft Skills \& Attributes**
* Knowledge of planning, management, and execution of Accelerated Solution Delivery framework
* Effective communication and collaboration skills
* Analytical and problem\-solving mindset
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Time management and prioritization
* Understanding of concepts: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and package solutions. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus.


**Additional Information**

title: Brand Alchemist
description:
**Brand Alchemist Apprentice (Content Creation \& Event Operations)** 




  





**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid – Remote Content Creation \+ On\-site Pop\-up Events)
 



**Position Type:** 
 Apprentice (12 months)
 



**Experience Level:** 
 Entry\-level / Student / Fresh Graduate
 



  





**About Us** 




  





**We are a newly launched, forward\-thinking luxury perfume brand based in Hyderabad. We craft exquisite, high\-concept fragrances that blend artistic storytelling with premium ingredients. As a modern luxury house, we don’t just sell scents—we curate olfactory experiences. We are looking for a dynamic, multi\-talented Intern who lives at the intersection of digital creativity and real\-world hustle to help us scale our brand presence.** 




  





**The Role** 




  





**This isn’t your typical coffee\-fetching internship. You will be a core part of our launch phase, acting as both the digital storyteller and the face of the brand at exclusive physical events. If you love aesthetics, have a knack for viral short\-form video content, and enjoy engaging with people in a premium retail environment, this role is for you.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Digital Content Creation \& Social Media** 



* **Short\-Form Video Production:** 
 Concept, shoot, and edit high\-quality Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikToks/social videos that reflect a luxury aesthetic.
* **Visual Storytelling:** 
 Capture behind\-the\-scenes footage, product aesthetics, and lifestyle content that elevates our brand narrative.
* **Instagram Management:** 
 Maintain a cohesive, premium grid layout; write engaging captions, manage community interactions (comments/DMs), and stay ahead of trending audio and formats.
* **Copywriting \& Blogging:** 
 Write engaging, SEO\-friendly short blogs and email newsletters detailing fragrance notes, brand stories, and perfume culture.



**2\. Pop\-Up Store \& Event Operations** 



* **Event Representation:** 
 Act as a brand ambassador at premium pop\-up stores, exhibitions, and launch events across Hyderabad.
* **Experiential Sales:** 
 Engage with luxury clientele, tell our brand story, guide customers through fragrance consultations, and drive on\-site sales.
* **Merchandising \& Setup:** 
 Assist in setting up and styling the visual display of the pop\-up store to ensure it meets luxury standards.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **The Aesthetic Eye:** 
 A strong sense of visual design, color theory, and luxury branding. You know how to make a product look expensive on camera.
* **Editing Tools Ninja:** 
 Mastery of mobile and desktop editing apps (CapCut, VN Video Editor, Adobe Premiere, or Canva), and AI content creation prompts etc.
* **People Person:** 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You are confident, articulate, and comfortable selling to high\-net\-worth individuals.
* **Self\-Starter:** 
 A hustle mentality. You thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment and don't need micro\-management.
* **Location:** 
 Must be based in or able to commute easily within Hyderabad for weekend/evening pop\-up events.



**Bonus Points If You Have:** 



* A personal interest or background in perfumery, fashion, or luxury lifestyle retail.
* A portfolio or a personal public social media account showcasing your content creation/editing skills.



  





**Perks \& Benefits** 




  




* **Stipend:** 
 Competitive monthly stipend.
* **Mentorship:** 
 Direct mentorship from the founding team, offering deep insights into building a luxury brand from scratch.
* **Flexible Schedule:** 
 Flexible hours for content creation and strategy, with dedicated on\-site hours during event days.
* **Product Perks:** 
 Exclusive employee discounts.
* **Growth Opportunity:** 
 Potential to transition into a full\-time role based on performance and brand growth.


- 


**How to Apply** 




  





**Challenge:** 
 Include a 30\-second conceptual video or a mood board showing how you would visually introduce a new luxury unisex fragrance to Instagram.

**Job Summary**
 GeoSpatial Senior Analyst MAP will design maintain and optimize Splunk based monitoring and analytics solutions to support complex geospatial data platforms in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on ensuring high availability performance and observability of mission critical systems while driving data driven insights that improve operational efficiency and contribute to safer smarter infrastructure for clients across global markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and maintain robust Splunk administration configurations that support large scale geospatial data ingestion indexing and search to ensure reliable analytics for business stakeholders.
* Configure and optimize Splunk infrastructure components including deployment servers forwarder management and app configurations to achieve consistent performance and operational stability in a hybrid work environment.
* Develop complex Splunk queries dashboards and alerts tailored for geospatial data patterns to provide actionable insights that improve situational awareness and decision support across business functions.
* Implement rigorous data onboarding processes within Splunk for diverse geo referenced data sources ensuring accurate timestamping field extraction and metadata standards that enhance analytic quality.
* Monitor Splunk platform health capacity and resource utilization proactively tuning indexing and search strategies to maintain high availability and meet demanding service level expectations for day shifts.
* Collaborate with application owners and data engineering teams to translate monitoring requirements into Splunk use cases improving fault detection incident response and root cause analysis for geospatial solutions.
* Establish and refine Splunk role based access controls and configurations that uphold strong security compliance while enabling flexible analytics for operational and strategic teams.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive Splunk documentation including runbooks configuration baselines and operational procedures to support consistent maintenance and efficient onboarding of new team members.
* Coordinate Splunk upgrade activities app lifecycle management and change implementations to ensure smooth transitions minimal downtime and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Analyze log and metric data within Splunk to identify performance bottlenecks recurring errors and optimization opportunities that enhance the reliability of map based applications.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating new Splunk capabilities and administrative best practices and recommending enhancements that increase automation resilience and insight generation.
* Support incident and problem management activities during day shifts by using Splunk searches and dashboards to quickly isolate issues and propose corrective actions for geospatial platforms.
* Engage with internal clients to understand analytic requirements for map centric workflows and translate those needs into scalable Splunk visualizations and alerts that amplify operational impact.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Splunk administration including deployment architecture configuration management and app lifecycle operations gained through six to ten years of hands on experience.
* Apply strong expertise in designing Splunk dashboards searches and alerts for complex technical environments with a focus on geo referenced and spatially dense data sets.
* Utilize solid understanding of enterprise monitoring logging and observability concepts to integrate Splunk with various data pipelines systems and applications in a hybrid operating model.
* Bring practical experience with performance tuning indexing best practices and capacity planning for Splunk to sustain reliable operations for mission critical mapping and analytics platforms.
* Exhibit working knowledge of general networking operating systems and application architectures to diagnose issues surfaced by Splunk and communicate findings effectively to cross functional teams.
* Present clear and structured communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders share insights from Splunk analytics and contribute to continuous service improvements without requiring business travel.

title: Senior Manager – Identity & Cloud Security
description:
**The Next Level of Fire \& Life Safety Leadership**
 With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
   

  

 At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry\-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting\-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
   

  

**Senior Manager – Identity \& Cloud Security**
**Reports to: Chief Information Security Officer**
**Location: Hyderabad, India**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced identity and cloud security leader to own how we protect access and secure our cloud estate worldwide. You will be the enterprise owner of Identity and Access Management — covering workforce, partner, customer, service, and workload identities — and will own cloud security across AWS, Azure, and Microsoft 365, with lighter\-touch accountability for SaaS security posture. This is both a leadership role and a strategic one: you will set the direction for how our identity and cloud security capabilities evolve, and lead a small, highly skilled engineering team supported by specialist delivery partners.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead the global identity and cloud security function — setting strategy, architecture, and engineering direction, and managing a team of up to four engineers plus contingent labor, managed services, and integration partners.
* Own enterprise Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, driving modern authentication and access control including MFA, passwordless, self\-service password reset, Conditional Access, and role\-based access control.
* Lead single sign\-on and federation across the application estate using SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, and SCIM, and advance Zero Trust and adaptive, risk\-based access.
* Own identity governance and privileged access — Saviynt IGA, PAM and PIM, identity lifecycle and joiner\-mover\-leaver processes, access and privileged access reviews, and service\-account governance.
* Deploy Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) and Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) to find and close identity attack paths.
* Define cloud security architecture, guardrails, and secure baselines for AWS and Azure, and mature posture and workload protection through CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, and CNAPP tooling, policy\-as\-code, and DevSecOps practice.
* Own the Microsoft 365 security control baseline — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Purview, DLP, and data classification — alongside SaaS security posture management.
* Support audit, governance, and risk management across SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS Benchmarks, and act as the identity and cloud authority during incident response and secure design reviews.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in cybersecurity or identity and access management, including 5\+ years leading teams in a global environment.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, PIM, and Identity Protection.
* Proven delivery of IGA and PAM platforms at enterprise scale — Saviynt or equivalent — covering identity lifecycle, JML, and access reviews.
* Strong command of federation and modern authentication standards: SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SCIM, RBAC and ABAC.
* Demonstrable experience securing AWS and Azure at scale, with working knowledge of native security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, KMS, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Key Vault, and Sentinel.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 security and data protection, including Defender, Purview, and DLP.
* Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, and SOX, with experience leading internal and external audits.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP, or platform certifications in Microsoft, AWS, Saviynt, or leading PAM products.
* Experience with CIAM, ZTNA, SaaS security posture management (SSPM), CASB, or secure service edge.
* Exposure to manufacturing environments and ISA 62443, or to identity workstreams in carve\-outs, divestitures, and tenant\-to\-tenant migrations.


**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
 Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire \& life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry\-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (F&B Chains)
description:
Hyderabad · Full\-time · On\-site with clients
 



**What Friday is** 




 Friday is an AI operator platform for restaurants. Restaurant data sits scattered across the POS, aggregators, bank statements and half a dozen spreadsheets. Friday pulls it into one place so owners can actually run the business from it. Friday is built by Numerize, which automates end\-to\-end bookkeeping for restaurant chains.
 



**What you'll do** 




 You're placed with a restaurant chain after it goes live on Friday, and you work from inside their business.
 


* Understand how the business works internally: what happens between an order, an invoice, a payout and the books, and where it breaks.
* Rebuild those processes on Friday, and automate what can be automated.
* Work with the people who'll use it — the outlet manager, the accountant, the chef — until they actually use it.
* Sit in the leadership review and push Friday into daily use. You don't have to run the meeting; you have to leave it with people using the product.
* Feed what you learn back to our product team, so the next client gets it out of the box.



**Who you are** 



* **You did engineering but you're not an engineer.** 
  A technical degree, and a technical way of breaking a problem down, applied to business rather than to code.
* **You've spent 5–8 years in business roles:** 
  business analyst, business or revenue operations, strategy and planning, founder's office, category or programme management. Or you've run your own business.
* **You read internal processes quickly.** 
  Given access and a few days, you can map how work actually flows through a company and say where it breaks.
* **You're hands\-on with AI.** 
  You use it daily to get your own work done.
* **You have a business mind.** 
  You understand how a business works end to end: what makes it money, what wastes it, and why people do things the way they do. You don't need to be a finance person.
* **You can talk to anyone.** 
  A CEO and an accountant and a cashier, on the same day, with the same ease.
* **You're easy to be around.** 
  A kitchen at 8pm is chaos and a month\-end close is stressful. We want someone who stays calm, keeps it light, and doesn't create drama. The client lives with you day in, day out.



**Not for you if** 



* You're a core developer or an IT person. You won't write services, build integrations or own a tech stack here.
* You want a pure analysis job. You'll be sitting with the people who do the work, not sending them a report.
* You'd rather hand over a recommendation than get the thing used.



**Restaurant experience is not required.** 
  We'll teach you the business: time in the outlets, a stock count, a month\-end close with our bookkeeping team.
 



**How to apply** 




 Please fill in the application form: \*https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfLncQteIEQEY\-DPrXB0\_fRWVo3\_9utJUlsoA7jaOusNSFBMg/viewform\*
 



 It asks for your CV and a 2\-minute video:
 


1. A quick introduction — who you are and what you're doing now.
2. An internal process you changed, and how you got people to actually use it.
3. How you use AI in your own work.



 The video matters more than the CV. No need to dress it up; talk to us the way you'd talk to a colleague.
 



 Applications sent any other way won't be tracked, so please use the form.

title: General Surgeon
description:
**Company Description** 
 Healing Hands Clinic is a specialty clinic focused on constipation, piles, hernia, and prevention of lifestyle\-related diseases. Located in the heart of the city, the clinic offers expert consultation, state\-of\-the\-art technology, and a highly qualified clinical and support team. Established in 2009, Healing Hands Clinic is ISO 9001:2008 certified and recognized by the European Colorectal Technology Association (ECTA). It was the first clinic in the city to introduce Defecography for constipation, reflecting its commitment to advanced diagnostics. The clinic emphasizes compassionate, patient\-centered care and has built a strong reputation based on positive outcomes and patient satisfaction.
 



**Role Description** 
 The General Surgeon will provide comprehensive surgical care for conditions such as hernia, piles, and other gastrointestinal and lifestyle\-related disorders treated at Healing Hands Clinic. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting patient assessments, recommending appropriate surgical or non\-surgical interventions, performing surgeries and procedures, and managing pre\-operative and post\-operative care. The role also involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, maintaining accurate medical records, adhering to clinical protocols, and participating in continuous quality improvement and clinical audits. This is a full\-time, on\-site position based at Healing Hands Clinic in the Hyderabad Division, requiring a strong commitment to safe, evidence\-based, and empathetic patient care.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Medicine and Surgery, with the ability to diagnose and manage a wide range of surgical conditions.
* Valid medical degree (MBBS or equivalent) and recognized postgraduate qualification in General Surgery (MS, DNB, or equivalent).
* Current registration with the appropriate medical council and compliance with all regulatory and ethical guidelines.
* Demonstrated experience in performing common general surgical procedures, ideally including colorectal and hernia surgery.
* Excellent clinical judgment, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a patient\-centered and gender\-neutral approach to care.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and adapt to a high\-volume, specialty clinic environment.
* Commitment to continuous professional development, adherence to evidence\-based practice, and participation in training or quality initiatives.

title: Builder 3
description:
BUILDER 3 — Systemic Orchestration
   

  

**Level:** 
 3 (Lead / Technical Direction)
   

  

**The Squad:** 
 You are the technical lead of the "Modernization Strike Team" — a small squad of Builders rewriting how enterprise software is built, tested and operated using AI. You are not the people manager. You are the person whose judgment the squad borrows when the agent works on Tuesday and fails on Friday.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 A Builder 2 makes an agent work. You make it work
 *every time* 
 , at a cost we can defend, on systems we cannot afford to break. Your job is to turn a collection of clever agents into a dependable production capability across a 20\-year\-old ERP estate. If you think "it worked in the demo" is a finish line, you will hate it here.
   

  

 The Builder Levels: A Hierarchy of Acceleration
   

  

* BUILDER 1 (Professional) — AI\-Assisted Execution. Uses AI to write code, tests and documentation 3x faster than a traditional junior. Learning to string together basic chains and prompts.
* BUILDER 2 (Senior) — Agentic Implementation. The engine room. Doesn't just use AI; builds the agents. Takes a legacy module and builds a LangGraph or CrewAI flow to modernize it with minimal supervision.
* BUILDER 3 (Lead) — Systemic Orchestration. ? You are here. Designs the Guardrail Layers and the Eval Frameworks. Ensures the agents built by the squad are reliable, cost\-effective and scalable.
* BUILDER 4 (Principal/Architect) — The Meta\-Platform. Builds the internal Builder Tools the other three levels use. Works the 12\-month horizon of model capability and readies the ERP architecture for autonomous operation.


**The honest boundary:** 
 B2 owns
 *an agent* 
 . B3 owns
 *whether the squad's agents are allowed near production* 
 . B4 owns
 *the platform the squad builds on* 
 . If you are still measured mainly by the modules you personally shipped, you are a strong B2\. If you are measured by whether other people's agents survive contact with production, you are a B3\.
   

  

 The Builder\-3 Profile
   

  

 You are a systems engineer for non\-deterministic systems. You are comfortable saying "no, not yet" to a working demo, and you can say exactly what would change your mind.2\. The Three Things You OwnWhat You'll Actually DoWhat Good Looks Like
   

  

* Core DNA (shared foundation, at lead altitude)
* AI\-Native Workflow. You don't just use AI tools fast — you set the squad's bar for what "fast and safe" looks like, and you remove the bottleneck when someone hits one.
* Agentic Architecture. You still build end\-to\-end agents yourself, and you do. But your leverage comes from designing the state management, tool interfaces and failure semantics that everyone else builds inside.
* Legacy\-to\-Modern Sequencing. You decide which legacy modules get modernized first, based on blast radius, data gravity and how cheaply success can be measured — not on which one looks most fun.
* Measured Reliability. You define what "reliable enough" means for each workflow: acceptance thresholds, regression suites, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, rollback paths. You know that "100% accurate" is a marketing phrase, and that the engineering version is a measured error rate with a defined containment strategy.
* The Guardrail Layer Input and output validation, tool\-permission scoping, financial and PII data handling, sandboxed execution, human approval gates on irreversible actions, kill switches, blast\-radius containment. You assume the agent will eventually do the wrong thing, and you design so that it costs us a log line instead of a General Ledger.
* The Eval Framework Golden datasets built from real ERP edge cases. Offline evals in CI as a merge gate, online evals in production. LLM\-as\-judge calibrated against human labels — and you know when that calibration has drifted. Regression detection when a model version, prompt or retrieval index changes underneath you. You move the squad from "prompt vibes" to a number that can fail a build.
* The Cost \& Performance Envelope Model routing, caching, context budgeting, latency budgets. You track token cost per completed business transaction, not per call, and you can tell the CFO why a workflow costs what it costs and where the next 40% comes from.
* Elective Depth (be deep in one, fluent in all six)
* Agentic Architect (Systems) — state management and tool\-calling interfaces for long\-running business processes across complex ERP schemas.
* UX/Interaction (Product) — generative UIs and browser\-use agents; designing where the human stays in the loop and where they don't need to be.
* Data \& Context (Data) — RAG and knowledge\-graph architecture: vector stores, chunking strategy, retrieval evals, and the relationship between a Purchase Order and a GL entry.
* Reliability \& Eval (QA) — programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), red\-teaming agents, adversarial testing of financial logic.
* Infra \& Agent\-Ops (DevOps) — the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the "thoughts" of the AI; deployment and rollback of prompts and models as versioned artifacts.
* Domain Logic Translation (Business) — turning 50 pages of accounting regulation into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.
* Set the definition of shippable. Write the standard for when an agent can touch production data, and enforce it in code, not in a wiki page.
* Build the eval harness and wire it into CI as a gate that can and does block merges.
* Design the guardrails around regulated and financial logic, including the human approval and rollback paths.
* Run design reviews. Kill bad agent architectures in week one instead of month four. Be specific about why.
* Own agent incidents. Pull the traces, find the root cause, and add the eval that makes that failure impossible to reintroduce.
* Make build\-vs\-buy calls on frameworks, vendors and models — and revisit them when the ground shifts, which it will.
* Grow Builder 1s and 2s through code review, design review and pairing. Not through ceremony.


*(Targets to be agreed with the hiring manager — these are illustrative, not fixed.)*
* 90 days: Eval harness running in CI on at least two live agentic workflows, with a published reliability baseline. A written, enforced guardrail standard.
* 6 months: Every production agent has a regression suite, a cost\-per\-transaction number, and a rollback path. Agent\-related incidents are down and post\-incident evals exist for each.
* 12 months: The squad ships agentic modules on a predictable cadence without you in the critical path of each one.


 The Stack
   

  

 Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights \& Biases, OpenTelemetry — plus the orchestration layer you'll live in: eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), policy and guardrail tooling, model routing and caching. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.
   

  

 Who You Are
   

  

* You've been burned. You have shipped an agentic system to real users, watched it fail in a way you didn't predict, and changed your architecture because of it. This is the single strongest signal for this level.
* Rigor over hype. You love new models and you still ask for the eval numbers first. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production\-grade agent handling financial data.
* Agent\-first thinker. You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* The manual\-task hater. If you do a task twice, you've already started drafting the workflow that kills it.
* Technically fearless. A 500\-table undocumented legacy schema is a puzzle, not a threat.
* A multiplier. Your best week is one where the squad shipped three things and you wrote one design doc and two brutal, useful reviews.


 Why Join Us
   

  

* The Final Boss of complexity. ERPs are the hardest problem in software for AI. Automate a General Ledger and you've mastered the game.
* Agentic autonomy. We don't do tickets. We do missions. You choose the models, frameworks and architectures you believe will win.
* No red tape. If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a "Does It Work?" policy. Note that you are the person who defines what "works" means.
* The Builder Tribe. You will not be the only AI person in the room. You'll lead a squad of people as obsessed with moving 10x faster as you are.

description:
Insight Global is one of the world's largest staffing firms. What does that mean? We make hiring easy for our clients. Since 2001, we've expanded from a small entrepreneurial startup to over $5 billion in revenue. Our growth is driven by our award\-winning company culture, comprehensive training programs, and of course, our people.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 We are seeking a high\-energy, strategic Talent Acquisition Manager who will build and scale our internal TA engine from the ground up. This role is responsible for designing and owning the full TA roadmap for India – from internal processes and employer branding to candidate experience, campus strategy, and team leadership – while directly supporting high\-priority hiring across IT, Solutions, Delivery, and Recruiting/Sales roles. You will operate as both a builder and a doer: someone who can create the vision, design the playbook, and then roll up your sleeves to execute, iterate, and scale. This is a high\-impact leadership role for a culture\-first people leader who embodies Insight Global’s Shared Values and can build a high performing team. At Insight Global, we don’t recruit like everyone else, and we don’t want to. The right person for this role will think creatively, challenge traditional campus hiring approaches, and help redefine what great recruiting looks like at scale.
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across priority hiring needs for the Hyderabad delivery center as well as campus hiring strategy. Ensure strong alignment to business demand, hiring quality, and speed across technical, delivery, solutions, and fresh graduates across sales/recruiting.
* Proven track record of building or scaling TA processes, programs, or teams from the ground up – including design, rollout, and continuous improvement of recruiting operations, tools, and governance.
* Serve as a strategic talent acquisition partner to leaders across India and the US by aligning on hiring priorities, calibrating expectations, and ensuring a consistent, collaborative approach across teams and stakeholders.
* A builder’s mindset: creative, solutions\-oriented, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and excited to design something new rather than just maintain existing processes.
* Build, execute, and continuously improve scalable campus recruiting strategies aligned to business growth. Develop and maintain strong relationships with career centers, faculty, and student organizations across target universities in India.

Provide market insights, talent trends, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Track and report on key recruiting metrics (time\-to\-hire, conversion rates, campus ROI, etc.)



  





 WHAT WE LOOK FOR
 


* 8\-12 years of full\-cycle recruitment experience, including significant ownership of mid to senior\-level hiring in India, ideally within high\-growth or services\-focused organizations. Experience hiring across technical (IT), Solutions, or Delivery\-based roles, non\-IT with an emphasis Sales/Recruiting roles preferred.
* 5 Years of Team Handling Experiences.
* Proven experience operating as a lead/manager and can both execute and develop hiring
* processes, influence stakeholders, and elevate how the organization attracts and selects talent.
* Strong track record of high activity, strong metrics, and operational excellence.
* Experience enhancing employer brand and talent market reputation by representing the
* company externally, shaping candidate messaging, and supporting or leading branding initiatives
* and events.
* Creative, solutions\-oriented mindset with a history of bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches
* to sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and conversion across the entire hiring lifecycle.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self\-motivated with strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Willingness to travel for campus engagement events as needed.
* Demonstrates high character, grit, and a positive, team\-oriented mindset.

title: HSEQ Assurance Analyst
description:
**About SkySpecs:** 




 At SkySpecs, our mission is to simplify renewable asset management so less can do more for the planet. SkySpecs is making this possible by automating wind farm operations and maintenance with advanced robotics paired with our custom\-built asset performance management software, Horizon. SkySpecs launched the world’s first completely autonomous blade inspection product in 2016 with a custom\-designed drone system. Since then, SkySpecs has inspected over 90% of US wind turbines and expanded globally, becoming the world leader in understanding turbine blade health. Identifying issues with turbine blades is only the first step. In 2019, SkySpecs launched Horizon, a platform for SkySpecs to offer a multi\-layered solution for customers that includes: data collection, wind turbine blade engineering expertise, and a place for all stakeholders to collaborate to manage and analyze massive amounts of data, spot trends, and create plans for high\-cost repair campaigns. In 2021, SkySpecs acquired two companies specializing in wind turbine drivetrain monitoring and financial management, further expanding our asset management portfolio. Ultimately, this will help reduce the cost and risk of operations for the industry.
 



  





**What will you be getting into?** 




 The HSEQ Assurance Analyst supports SkySpecs’ global HSEQ function through data\-driven operational assurance and compliance activities. The role reviews inspection imagery and other operational data to identify potential safety concerns and compliance trends, while supporting customer compliance platforms, HSEQ systems, and routine compliance activities.
 



  





**As HSEQ Assurance Analyst, you will:** 




**Operational Assurance \& Analysis:** 



* Conduct systematic reviews of inspection imagery to assess observable compliance with defined HSEQ requirements.
* Review other operational monitoring data introduced through the HSEQ assurance program.
* Record and analyse assurance findings to identify recurring trends, behaviours and areas of increased operational risk.
* Maintain accurate assurance records, trackers, metrics and dashboards.
* Escalate significant findings, potential non\-compliance and emerging trends to the appropriate HSEQ representative for further review.



  





**HSEQ Compliance \& Support** 



* Maintain customer compliance platforms, including ISNetworld, Veriforce, ComplyWorks, Achilles and other customer\-specific systems.
* Coordinate the collection and maintenance of HSEQ documentation, records, certifications and supporting evidence.
* Support routine HSEQ reporting, audit preparation, action tracking and management\-system activities.
* Maintain accurate HSEQ records and assist with general compliance and administrative activities.
* Work collaboratively with all stakeholders to support continuous improvement



  





**Requirements of the job:** 



* Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately review high volumes of imagery and operational data.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to identify patterns and trends.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Confident using spreadsheets, databases, dashboards and online systems.
* Ability to consistently apply defined criteria and accurately record findings.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within a fully remote environment with flexible hours to accommodate work schedules across all North American and European time zones.



  





**Bonus Point:** 



* Previous HSEQ, compliance, quality or assurance experience.
* Experience with customer compliance platforms such as ISNetworld, Veriforce, ComplyWorks \& Achilles.
* Experience reviewing imagery, telematics or operational data.
* Experience within renewable energy or another safety\-critical industry.
* Awareness of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001



  





**Perks of the Job:** 



* Time Off: Generous leave policy—among the best in the industry.
* Global Team: Work with teammates across 5 countries and diverse backgrounds.
* Impact: Help build the backbone of clean energy digital infrastructure.

title: Manager, Engineering  (Platform Engineering)
description:
**About ScienceLogic…**
 ScienceLogic is redefining IT operations for the modern enterprise. Our AIOps platform empowers organizations to achieve Autonomic IT — where systems are self\-healing, self\-optimizing, and seamlessly aligned with business outcomes. We help enterprises and service providers gain unified visibility across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments, automate workflows, and unlock performance at scale.
   

  

 We’re accelerating digital transformation through the power of automation, AI, and analytics — giving IT and business leaders the tools to deliver superior customer experiences, drive efficiency, and innovate with confidence.
   

  

**Work Location: Hyderabad**
**What We're Looking For...**
 ScienceLogic is hiring a hands\-on Engineering Manager to lead our Platform Engineering team in Hyderabad. This role will manage a ten\-person team responsible for the infrastructure, systems, and test automation that our SkylarOne hybrid cloud monitoring platform runs on. You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India), with a dotted line to the Sr. Director of Engineering (US), and you'll sit on the India engineering leadership team. This role is ideal for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys staying close to technical decision\-making while building organizational scale. You'll provide leadership across platform modernization, reliability, and operational excellence while developing future team leaders and strengthening the team's management structure.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. We are a global, growing software company reinventing the way companies manage their hybrid cloud data and systems by driving operational and business insights from the extensive data types contained in the SkylarOne data lake with AI.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing...**
 You'll lead a ten\-person team comprised of full\-time employees and contractors, covering the following day\-to\-day:
   

  

* Owning technical direction and architecture for SkylarOne platform modernization, including OS migrations, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability.
* Managing delivery across systems engineering, DevOps/test infrastructure, and networking, staying hands\-on with design reviews, troubleshooting, and code/config review while delegating as the team grows.
* Developing future leaders within the organization and building an effective management and technical leadership structure that supports team growth and scale.
* Partnering with the QA Engineering Manager, the Solutions Engineering Manager, and India\-based Product Owners to align platform work with product and quality roadmaps.
* Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for direct reports.
* Representing the India platform team in planning and reviews with Mahesh Hanumanula and other US engineering leadership.
* Driving infrastructure cost optimization and rightsizing across on\-premises (VMware) and AWS environments.
* Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and driving continuous improvement in system operations and release readiness.


**Qualities you possess...**
**Must Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams. People\-management experience is required for this role, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Demonstrated experience growing a team's structure, hiring into a growing org, and ideally building or mentoring a first layer of team leads.
* A hands\-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.


**Good To Have**
* AWS experience or certification.
* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).
* Exposure to AI\-driven development practices or AI coding assistants.
* CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certification.
* Experience with distributed systems or large\-scale data processing environments.


*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*
**About ScienceLogic**
 ScienceLogic is a leader in IT Operations Management, providing modern IT operations with actionable insights to resolve and predict problems faster in a digital, ephemeral world. Its solution sees everything across cloud and distributed architectures, contextualizes data through relationship mapping, and acts on this insight through integration and automation.

 VitaInspire Private Limited📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-Time \| Onsite🏥 Healthcare \| 🎓 Education \| 🤖 Agentic AI \| 🌍 Social ImpactImportant:
 



 This is a Hyderabad\-based onsite role.
 



  





 Candidates should be based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate and must be available to attend an in\-person interview in Hyderabad.
 



  





 About VitaInspire
 



 At VitaInspire, we are building practical AI solutions designed to create meaningful impact in healthcare and education particularly for communities underserved by technology.We are now building the next generation of Agentic AI systems—AI agents that can reason, collaborate, use tools, access knowledge, make decisions, and execute complex real\-world workflows.We are looking for an exceptional AI Agentic Systems Lead who wants to build these systems from the ground up.
 



  





 🚀 The Opportunity
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on builder who has experience developing production\-grade Agentic AI systems and understands how to take an idea from 0 → 1 → production.You will:• Architect and build production\-grade multi\-agent AI systems• Design agent orchestration, planning, memory, communication, and tool\-use architectures• Build agents that execute real\-world workflows• Develop RAG and knowledge\-grounded agent systems• Integrate agents with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and external tools• Implement agent evaluation, observability, reliability, and monitoring• Evaluate emerging Agentic AI frameworks, models, and protocols• Lead and mentor a small AI engineering team while remaining deeply hands\-on• Own architecture, technical decisions, delivery, and outcomes• Move rapidly from idea → prototype → productionWe are looking for a builder, not a technology follower.
